classification_categories.power_calc: Formal a priori power calculation (α, β, effect size specified)
classification_categories.effect_size_estimate: Quantitative estimate from pilot/literature, no formal calc
classification_categories.replication_standard: Appeal to field convention or replication of prior study
classification_categories.resource_constraint: Sample size limited by availability, budget, or cohort size
classification_categories.methodology_determined: Sample size inherently defined by measurement technique or study design (stereology, cryo-EM, single-molecule imaging, complete-specimen census); no separate determination step expected
classification_categories.no_justification: n stated but no reasoning provided
classification_categories.na_or_blank: Field empty, N/A, or not applicable
classification_categories.ambiguous: Text present but insufficient to classify

records.sample_size_raw: Sample sizes were chosen based on commonly accepted standards in molecular biology.

records.title: A direct role for a mitochondrial targeting sequence in signalling stress
records.sample_size_raw: All sample sizes and the number of biological replicates for each experiment are reported in the figure legends. No statistical methods were used to predetermine sample size. For live-cell imaging analyses, sample sizes were guided by preliminary experiments that helped establish an appropriate sample size for the purpose of this study. For other assays, the number of experiments performed followed standard practices in the field.

records.title: Sterilization and contraception increase lifespan across vertebrates
records.sample_size_raw: For the zoo data, we selected datasets for which we had at least 30 individuals per type of contraception, such that the total number of individuals (contracepted + non-contracepted) was at least 100. For the competing risk modelling we selected species for which there were at least 15 individuals with cause of death information in the contracepted category, for a minimum of 50 between contracepted and non-contracepted. Sample sizes used were based on the minimum deemed required for sufficient estimation of the related effect sizes.

records.title: Palaeometabolomes yield biological and ecological profiles at early human sites
records.sample_size_raw: Twenty extant laboratory mouse bones representing two different strains, six 1.7-1.8 and 1.3 myr Olduvai Gorge fossils, one 2.4 myr Chiwondo Beds fossil, one 3.0 myr Makapansgat fossil, six species-matched extant faunal bones, and eight paleosols were subject to destructive analysis. Sample data is unique to individuals.

records.title: RNA-triggered Cas12a3 cleaves tRNA tails to execute bacterial immunity
records.sample_size_raw: Quantitative experiments involved a sample size of at least three, the minimal number needed to perform statistical analyses. The exact sample size is indicated in each figure legend.

records.title: Nutrient requirements of organ-specific metastasis in breast cancer
records.sample_size_raw: Statistical methods were not performed to pre-determine sample size for animal studies. The number of animals assigned per condition was selected empirically to account for the variability of the examined phenotypes based on prior experience with the model, as described in refs. 12, 13. For tissue culture experiments, statistical methods were not performed to pre-determine sample sizes. All tissue culture experiments were performed with sample sizes of n = 3 independent biological replicates per condition. This number was selected based on prior experience showing that n = 3 consistently captures biological variability and is sufficient to detect reproducible and statistically significant differences in cell growth and metabolite abundance between experimental conditions.
